targetText:
Capital ; profit (profit of enterprise plus interest),
land ; ground-rent, labour ; wages, this is the trinity formula
which comprises all the secrets of the social production process.
explanation: Marx critiques mainstream economics for treating capital, land, and labor as separate sources of wealth, obscuring how profit, interest, and rent all stem from unpaid worker surplus labor.

targetText:
First, the alleged sources of the annually available wealth belong to widely
dissimilar spheres and are not at all analogous with one another. They have
about the same relation to each other as lawyer's fees, red beets and
music.
explanation: Marx uses humor to show how illogical it is to group capital, land, and labor together as equal income sources; it makes as much sense as grouping lawyer fees, red beets, and music!
